Behind the kitchen

About Rest in Cheese

The story behind our kitchen.

Training as a former intern at The Landmark Mandarin Oriental taught me that fine pastry isn't about expensive labels—it's about technique, patience, and honoring ingredients. Rest in Cheese is born from that philosophy, handcrafted right from our home kitchen in Taman Grisenda, Pantai Indah Kapuk.

Main ingredients: Cheesecake, graham crumble, local ingredients
Shelf life & storage: Keep refrigerated, consume within 3 days
Ordering system: Order before midnight, delivered next morning
Delivery area: Jakarta, delivery fee based on area

Refund & Cancellation

Orders are prepared for the delivery date you choose, so they cannot be cancelled once paid. If a jar arrives damaged or incorrect, message us on WhatsApp within [2 hours] of delivery with a photo and your order number. We will replace it or refund it to the original payment method.

Pesanan dibuat untuk tanggal kirim yang Anda pilih, jadi tidak bisa dibatalkan setelah dibayar. Jika jar rusak atau salah saat diterima, hubungi kami lewat WhatsApp dalam [2 jam] setelah diterima dengan foto dan nomor pesanan. Kami akan menggantinya atau mengembalikan dana ke metode pembayaran semula.

Privacy

We use your name, WhatsApp number, email, and address only to take and deliver your order and to send your receipt. Payments are processed by Midtrans. We never see or store your card or bank details. We do not sell your information.

Kami hanya menggunakan nama, nomor WhatsApp, email, dan alamat untuk memproses dan mengirim pesanan serta struk. Pembayaran diproses oleh Midtrans. Kami tidak melihat atau menyimpan data kartu atau rekening Anda, dan tidak menjual data Anda.

Terms

Prices are in Indonesian rupiah. Delivery is within Jakarta. The earliest delivery date is shown at checkout. Quantities are limited to what is available. A loyalty free jar is given for every 17 jars, and you choose its flavor. One coupon applies to one order.

Harga dalam Rupiah. Pengiriman hanya di Jakarta. Tanggal kirim paling awal ditampilkan saat checkout. Jumlah pesanan terbatas sesuai jar yang tersedia. Jar gratis dari program stamp diberikan setiap 17 jar, dan Anda memilih rasanya. Satu kupon berlaku untuk satu pesanan.
